The Seven Princes of Hell

In 1589 the German bishop Peter Binsfeld paired each deadly sin with a demon who rules it. The list has shaped sermons, poems and stories ever since. Choose a prince to read his full file.

Portraits are artwork supplied by the site owner. These profiles describe folklore, scripture and literature, not belief or practice. Binsfeld’s pairings are the most widely cited, but older and later sources assign the demons differently, and descriptions of their appearance vary by author and artist.
